payload.docs_match:

Trunk receives: engine/brief.ts (new), engine/phone.ts (rewritten - absolute URLs on BOTH actions, one-line link message, X-Click, per-announce transport, announce recording, a transport that no longer swallows non-2xx), the park seam in engine/wait.ts, the wiring in engine/tools.ts, bin/se-board.ts with its announce timer removed, tests/i8d-brief.test.ts (21 checks), and the ledger updates.

Configuration baselined by exclusion: phone.json and brief.json are machine-local and never packaged; the product runs silent without them.

payload.dependencies_ruled:
Zero runtime npm dependencies, held there deliberately - node:crypto plus the platform's Web Crypto (the same implementation the browser runs), and fetch.

One new external service: Cloudflare Workers KV as the brief host. Opt-in per machine, absent by default, NOT load-bearing - without it you lose the link and keep bless and dismiss.

kb stamped ABSENT on every grant. Nothing upstream patched or forked, so nothing deposited: both protocols behaved as specified and the failures were entirely ours.

FIVE TOOLING GAPS were found while building this and are now in RAID rather than absorbed silently, under the law you just set (se.law-workaround-then-record-the-gap): se_run bypasses the fence invisibly, se_file_patch has no batch mode, large files are unreadable through the lane, there is no lane for the machine-local config, and an iteration cannot exercise its own build through the live surface.
